items.name: Final Words
items.text: When Azotixo dies, he explodes in a burst of psychic energy. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation take 12d6 mental damage (DC 27 basic Will save save). His possessions are left in a pile where he died.

items.name: Leave in the Dark
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to Recall Knowledge about Azotixo and fails

---
Effect Failing to properly recognize the caligni archivist creates a mental feedback loop. If the triggering check was a failure, the creature is Off-Guard for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature becomes Confused for 1 round instead.

items.name: Recognize Opportunity
items.text: Azotixo deals 1d6 extra precision damage to frightened or Off-Guard creatures.

items.name: Rewrite Records
items.text:
Azotixo attempts to scramble the memories of a creature within 30 feet, filling their mind with terrifying images. The creature attempts a DC 30 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Rewrite Records for 1 day.

Success The creature takes 4d6 mental damage.

Failure The creature takes 8d6 mental damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is Frightened 2.
